description: Values for the NGX NFS CSI driver chart for Red Hat OpenShift

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Reviewed immutable release tag or digest. Do not use :latest in production.

logLevel.title: Console log level
logLevel.description: Verbosity of the driver console output. File logs remain detailed regardless of this value.

driverNamePrefix.title: Driver name prefix
driverNamePrefix.description: Single label prepended to the CSI driver name and to driver resource names. Empty preserves nfs.csi.ngxstorage.com and the nfs-csi-ngxstorage resource names; a non-empty prefix produces <prefix>.nfs.csi.ngxstorage.com (driver name) and <prefix>-nfs-csi-ngxstorage (resource names) so a second driver instance can serve a distinct NGX backend on the same cluster (for example 201 or 205).

namespace.title: Driver namespace
namespace.description: Namespace that owns all namespaced driver resources. Use a distinct namespace for each driver instance.

nodePlacement.title: Node pod placement
nodePlacement.description: Where the node DaemonSet may run. Use worker for a high-speed backend reachable only from worker NICs, master for control-plane-only placement, or all for the general-purpose backend.

secret.title: Backend Secret
secret.description: Prefer an existing Secret in production. Set create=true only when managing the Secret through Helm.

create.title: Create the Secret
create.description: When true, Helm creates the Secret from storageIPs/poolName/apiKey/dataIP. The API key is then stored in the rendered release metadata.

storageIPs.title: Storage IPs
storageIPs.description: Comma-separated NGX management API IPs. Required when secret.create=true.

poolName.title: Pool name
poolName.description: NGX share pool name. Required when secret.create=true.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: NGX management API key. Required when secret.create=true.

dataIP.title: Data IP
dataIP.description: NGX NFS data IP. Required when secret.create=true.

create.title: Create the VolumeSnapshotClass
create.description: When true, the chart installs a VolumeSnapshotClass. OpenShift owns the snapshot CRDs and controller; only disable this when the snapshot API is unavailable.

controllerPlacement.title: Controller pod placement
controllerPlacement.description: Where the controller Deployment may run. Use master (default) for control-plane placement, worker for worker-only, or all.

controllerLivenessPort.title: Controller liveness probe port
controllerLivenessPort.description: HTTP port for the controller liveness-probe sidecar. A second driver instance must use a different port.

nodeLivenessPort.title: Node liveness probe port
nodeLivenessPort.description: HTTP port for the node liveness-probe sidecar. A second driver instance in hostNetwork on the same worker must use a different port.
